blocks.translation: Clear Date
Around 1994

blocks.source: 1994年発売のスクウェア黄金期を代表するRPG。当時は11,400円（＋消費税3%）と高かった・・・。それでもなお満足させるだけの完成度があったのも確か。
blocks.translation: An RPG released in 1994 that represents Square's golden age. At the time, it was expensive at 11,400 yen (plus 3% consumption tax)... Even so, it certainly had enough polish to satisfy players.

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Substance / Story

blocks.source: 多数の仲間キャラクターが登場する物語。特定の主人公は明示されていない。FF4,5よりも更にSFよりの世界観で、魔法と機械が合わさった文明が表現されている。
blocks.translation: A story featuring a large number of companion characters. No specific protagonist is explicitly designated. Its world has an even stronger science-fiction flavor than FF4 and FF5, depicting a civilization where magic and machinery coexist.

blocks.source: 物語の前半と後半でガラッと変わるストーリーやゲームデザインが特徴的。前半はストーリーテンポが良く、めまぐるしく展開が変わる。途中でパーティが３つに分割してストーリーが進む箇所があるが、基本的には一本道で前の町に引き返したりできる機会は少ない。
blocks.translation: The story and game design change dramatically between the first and second halves, which is one of the game's defining features. The first half has a brisk story pace, with events unfolding rapidly. At one point, the party splits into three groups as the story progresses, but the game is basically linear, with few opportunities to return to previous towns.

blocks.source: そして後半は一転して、離散した仲間を集めることに。集める順番は自由なので、プレイヤーによって個性が出る。他にも後半はサブイベントが盛りだくさん。モンスターに吸い込まれることで、突入するダンジョンなんてよくぞ実装したものだと感心する。
blocks.translation: Then, in the second half, everything changes, and you must gather your scattered companions. Since you can choose the order in which to find them, each player's experience can be different. The second half is also packed with side events. I was impressed that they actually implemented a dungeon you enter by being swallowed by a monster.

blocks.source: イベント演出はSFCでも最高レベル。『オペラ』をシナリオに組み込むなど、こんな派手なことをしているのは、SFCではFF6ぐらいだろう。FF9のオープニングが演劇から始まるのはセルフオマージュだろうか。
blocks.translation: The event direction is among the best on the Super Famicom. Incorporating an “opera” into the scenario is just one example of the kind of spectacular thing that only FF6 would attempt on the Super Famicom. I wonder whether FF9's opening beginning with a stage play was a self-homage.

blocks.source: 隠し要素や小ネタが豊富で、普通にプレイしているだけでは気付かないようなモノも。中には、特定のキャラクターの生死に関わるイベントも存在する。もちろん、初回プレイにおいては気付かず、筆者は約２名程を見殺しにした。
blocks.translation: There are plenty of hidden elements and little secrets, including things you would never notice through normal play alone. Some events even determine whether specific characters live or die. Naturally, I failed to notice them during my first playthrough and ended up letting about two characters die.

blocks.source: シドは殺した方が流れが美しいので。
blocks.translation: Because the story flows more beautifully if Cid dies.

blocks.source: 何気に町人のセリフが超簡素。これを残念というべきか、簡潔というべきか・・・。DQと比較すると何だかシュールなので軽く紹介。
blocks.translation: The townspeople's lines are surprisingly terse. Should this be called disappointing or concise...? Compared with DQ, they feel somewhat surreal, so here is a brief introduction.

blocks.source: 「ここはサウスフィガロの町。」
blocks.translation: "This is the town of South Figaro."

blocks.source: 男たるもの余計なことは言わない。体言止めでクールに締める。
blocks.translation: A man says only what needs to be said. He ends things coolly with a sentence fragment.

blocks.source: 「えらいこっちゃね！
blocks.translation: "This is terrible!”

blocks.source: 帝国を敵にまわすとは……」
blocks.translation: “You mean to make an enemy of the Empire...?"

blocks.source: なぜか関西弁の少女。
blocks.translation: A girl who, for some reason, speaks in a Kansai dialect.

blocks.source: システム／バランス／快適性
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance / Comfort

blocks.source: 14人いる中から自由に4人を選択して編成する。実はパーティの入替えを自由にできる初のシリーズ作品だったりする。後半はパーティを2～3に分割して、切り替えながら進むダンジョンも存在。特にラストダンジョンはFF8に並ぶ作り込みだ。
blocks.translation: You freely choose four characters from a roster of 14 to form your party. In fact, this was the first game in the series to let you freely switch party members. In the second half, there are also dungeons where the party is split into two or three groups, and you progress by switching between them. The final dungeon in particular is as meticulously designed as FF8's.

blocks.source: 戦闘
blocks.translation: Battle

blocks.source: FF5と比較すると、魔法や特技の使用などに若干の間があるので、戦闘テンポは若干低下している。それでも十分にテンポ良い部類だとは思うけれど。
blocks.translation: Compared with FF5, there is a slight pause when using magic and Techs, so the battle pace is somewhat slower. Even so, I think it still falls into the sufficiently fast-paced category.

blocks.source: 各キャラクターはオリジナルコマンドを保有しており、それぞれの個性がある。格闘ゲームのようなコマンド入力で発動する『ひっさつわざ』、手に入れた道具で様々な効果を発揮する『きかい』など多種多様だ。でも『まふうけん』とか『ぬすむ』とか、キャラによって地味なのは少し悲しいかもしれない。他にも、HPが減って瀕死になった時のみ発動する隠し奥義なんてものも存在する。
blocks.translation: Each character has unique commands that give them their own individuality. They vary widely, from “Desperation Attack,” activated by fighting-game-style command inputs, to “Tools,” which produce various effects using items you have acquired. Still, it may be a little sad that some characters have rather plain abilities, such as “Runic” and “Steal.” There are also hidden Arts that activate only when a character's HP is low and they are near death.

blocks.source: 魔石システムによって、仲間へ自由に魔法を覚えさせることができる。これはオリジナルコマンドとは異なり、全キャラ共通の成長システムとなる。つまり、キャラの個性化と凝った成長システムという二兎を追う構成になっているわけだが、それなりにうまくいっているように思う。
blocks.translation: The magicite system lets you freely teach magic to your companions. Unlike the unique commands, this is a growth system shared by all characters. In other words, the game tries to pursue both character individuality and an elaborate growth system, and I think it works reasonably well.

blocks.source: 細かいところでは、FF5までは１人１つしか装備できなかったアクセサリが、２つまで装備できるようになっている。アクセサリの種類も豊富で、プレイヤーなりの個性付けが可能だ。これを複雑化したものが、FF7のマテリアと考えることもできそうだ。
blocks.translation: As a minor detail, accessories—which could only be equipped one per person through FF5—can now be equipped up to two at a time. There is also a wide variety of accessories, allowing players to customize their characters in their own way. It seems fair to view FF7's Materia as a more complex version of this system.

blocks.source: 難易度
blocks.translation: Difficulty

blocks.source: 難易度は序盤こそ優しいが後で難しくなる。ゲーム中盤のダンジョン『魔大陸』辺りからの難易度上昇は中々に厳しい。後半、パーティが離散してからしばらくは戦力も整わず、詰まりかけることも多いと思う。
blocks.translation: The difficulty is gentle at first but becomes harder later on. The increase in difficulty beginning around the mid-game dungeon “Floating Continent” is fairly severe. In the latter half, after the party scatters, your forces remain underdeveloped for a while, and I think many players will often find themselves close to getting stuck.

blocks.source: とはいえ、味方側もどんどん強くなるので、また楽になっていく。というか、今度は楽になりすぎて、ラストバトルの頃にはヌルゲーになっている可能性もおおいにある。なんせ、ラスボス最終形態のHPはたったの60000超。ダメージ9999以上の攻撃を普通に叩き出せるこのゲームでは瞬殺されるのも仕方がない。
blocks.translation: That said, your side also grows steadily stronger, so things become easier again. In fact, they may become too easy, to the point that the game could turn into a cakewalk by the final battle. After all, the final form of the last boss has only a little over 60,000 HP. In a game where attacks dealing over 9,999 damage can be produced routinely, getting killed instantly is only natural.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Art

blocks.source: 『オペラ』イベントでの演出は上で述べた通り。『飛空艇』や『魔導アーマー』を始めとした機械類のデザインセンスもさすが。様々なオリジナルコマンドから繰り出される戦闘アニメーションは個性豊か。魔法や幻獣（この作品の召喚獣）の種類も豊富だ。
blocks.translation: The presentation of the “opera” event is as described above. The design sense behind the machinery, including the “airship” and “Magitek Armor,” is also superb. The battle animations produced by the various unique commands are full of personality. There is also a wide variety of magic and espers (the summons in this game).

blocks.source: 難を言えば、ドット絵が暗いのは少々嫌かもしれない。特に後半はストーリーの関係でマップチップ（特にフィールド）が暗いのなんの・・・。
blocks.translation: If I had to name a flaw, it might be that the pixel art is somewhat dark. The map tiles—especially the field—are particularly dark in the second half because of the story... truly dark.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 作曲者は当然の植松伸夫氏なので、品質の高さは保証されている。ただ世界観の都合もあって、FF5と比べると暗い曲が多いのが悲しいところだ。しかし、そんな暗めなFF6において、後半に流れる『仲間を求めて』は希望あふれる名曲だ。暗くなりがちな後半を、この曲で大きく持ち直す。
blocks.translation: The composer is, of course, Nobuo Uematsu, so the high quality is guaranteed. However, partly because of the setting, it is unfortunate that there are more somber tracks than in FF5. Even so, in such a dark game as FF6, “Searching for Friends,” which plays in the second half, is a magnificent song overflowing with hope. This song greatly revitalizes the second half, which tends to become gloomy.

blocks.source: もちろん戦闘曲、ダンジョン曲なども豊富。ラスボス戦は、美術演出と併せて何の芸術を目指しているのかと思った程だ。
blocks.translation: Of course, there is also a wealth of battle and dungeon music. The final boss battle, combined with the visual presentation, made me wonder what form of art it was aiming to become.
